source.directorySummary: File manager plugin providing workspace tree browsing, file view/edit/create/delete/rename/restore, git history/diff/commit inspection, encrypted upload/download, and bottomup documentation workflows via a centralized command dispatcher, plugin registration, AI tooling, and fuzzy-file-search capability.

.gitignore.sourceSummary: Empty .gitignore file with no ignore patterns.

adapter.test.ts.sourceSummary: Tests parseFileInvocationFromJsonPayload preserves options when a file command has no positional arguments.

adapter.ts.sourceSummary: Routes file subcommands via handleFile and parses JSON and CLI invocations into adapter dispatch for help/upload/download/tree/commit and bottomup.* commands.

ai.ts.sourceSummary: Re-exports and wires the File plugin AiDefinition with ToolCallSchema, skill metadata, and tool execution helpers.

CHANGELOG.md.sourceSummary: Records versioned changelog entries for file plugin releases derived from git tags.

definition.ts.sourceSummary: Aggregates the file CommandDefinition combining help and all subcommand definitions into a single command spec.

fuzzy-file-search-provider.ts.sourceSummary: Implements the fuzzy-file-search capability provider that collects, filters by ignore/gitignore rules, and scores workspace files for substring/subsequence queries.

init.ts.sourceSummary: Registers FilePlugin BotPlugin wiring handler delegation to handleFile, help text, AI definition, command definition, stories, and capability providers.

LICENSE.sourceSummary: Provides the Unlicense public-domain dedication and warranty disclaimer.

package.json.sourceSummary: Declares appweaver-file-plugin package metadata, version 3.6.0, and provides fuzzy-file-search capability.

README.md.sourceSummary: Documents file plugin commands and the plugins/file/tree CLI usage rooted at process.cwd().

stories.ts.sourceSummary: Defines guided story demos for browsing the file tree, viewing/editing markdown, and reviewing diffs.

tree.sourceSummary: Thin Bun executable delegating to tree-cli main for workspace tree display.

summary.value: File manager plugin for workspace tree browsing, file view/edit/create/delete/rename/restore/search, git history/diff/commit inspection, encrypted Nostr/Blossom NIP-44/naddr upload/download, and bottom-up documentation workflows via centralized command dispatcher, plugin registration, AI tooling and fuzzy-file-search. commands/ is a container aggregating 20 subcommands split across file operations, git operations, bottomup pipeline (generate/summarize/enrich/summary), encrypted sharing and help — file/git commands follow validate workspace containment -> filesystem/git/ripgrep -> CLI text/web tree adaptation, bottomup commands share CLI/web adaptation, inherited context, SHA-256 hash caching, coverage/compact-summary validation and plan/draft/revise/accept lifecycle with modal diff/preview, supported by shared workspace-root resolution, path validation, git/IGNORE filtering, unified diff, Blossom transfer and breadcrumbs. ai/ provides Zod-validated bottomup schemas and runtime dispatch glue via workspace root with in-memory DB; types/ defines the adapter parameter contract. Coverage is complete for this directory and all children.

context.value: plugins/file — workspace file-manager plugin in AppWeaver system: tree browsing, view/edit/create/delete/rename/restore, git diff/history/commit/restore/init, NIP-44/Blossom encrypted upload/download, and bottom-up docs via centralized dispatcher + plugin registration + AI tooling + fuzzy-file-search; ai complete (Zod-validated bottomup.generate/enrich/summarize/summary contracts, runtime dispatch via workspace root, in-memory DB); commands complete container (20 CLI/web subcommands: bottomup workflows with coverage validation/effective context/hash-cache/recursive/one-level/plan-draft-accept and index validation/projections, filesystem ops with size/binary/IGNORE/.gitignore filtering via ripgrep, git ops, secure transfer with naddr/NIP-44/integrity handling, shared workspace-root validation/filter/renderer/help under containment); types complete (adapter param contracts); no missing/stale coverage.

enrichment.directorySummary: Architectural facade for all workspace persistence and inspection in the AppWeaver BotPlugin system. Sits between host runtime and filesystem/git/Blossom/bottomup subsystems behind a centralized dispatcher (adapter.ts/handleFile) and plugin registration (init.ts), delegating implementation to commands/ while exposing AI tooling contracts via ai/ + types/ and workspace discovery via the fuzzy-file-search capability. Enforces workspace-root containment and provides dual CLI-text/web-tree adaptation shared across subcommands.

files.adapter.test.ts: Regression guard for adapter dispatch edge case — verifies options are preserved when no positional args are present, ensuring JSON and CLI invocation parsing remains consistent for the centralized dispatcher.
files.adapter.ts: Invocation translation layer that normalizes both JSON and CLI forms into unified adapter dispatch routed through handleFile; entry point for help/upload/download/tree/commit and bottomup.* families.
files.ai.ts: Wiring re-export that binds the File plugin's AiDefinition, ToolCallSchema and skill metadata to executable tool helpers consumed by the agent framework.
files.CHANGELOG.md: Non-runtime release history artifact generated from git tags; provides version traceability for the plugin without participating in dispatch or registration.
files.definition.ts: Composition root merging help and the 20 subcommand definitions from commands/ into a single CommandDefinition consumed by dispatcher and BotPlugin registration.
files.fuzzy-file-search-provider.ts: Capability provider implementing the declared fuzzy-file-search — supplies filtered, scored workspace file listings with ripgrep/.gitignore/IGNORE filtering for AI tool and UI consumption.
files.init.ts: Plugin bootstrap registering FilePlugin with the AppWeaver lifecycle; wires handler delegation, command definition, AI definition, stories and capability providers into a single BotPlugin.
files.package.json: Package manifest establishing plugin identity as appweaver-file-plugin@3.6.0 and declaring the fuzzy-file-search capability for host discovery.
files.README.md: User-facing documentation surface describing file plugin commands and tree CLI usage rooted at process.cwd() for direct developer invocation.
files.stories.ts: Guided demo narratives that exercise the tree browsing, markdown view/edit and diff-review flows for story-driven documentation and onboarding.
files.tree: Executable shim delegating to tree-cli main; enables direct `plugins/file/tree` Bun invocation for workspace tree display outside the dispatcher path.
